title: WiGLE CSV Header Offset & Schema Parsing
description: The parser shall detect metadata headers and parse CSV content extracting SSID, MAC/BSSID, latitude, longitude, RSSI, channel, frequency, and accuracy, discarding non-WIFI or NaN coordinate records.
acceptance_criteria: Given raw WiGLE CSV text with pre-header metadata, when parsed, valid WIFI points with numeric coordinates are returned and invalid or non-WIFI rows are excluded.

title: SSID Normalization and Frequency Band Filtering
description: The parser shall normalize empty SSIDs, support filtering by exact SSID or all networks, and support filtering by 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.
acceptance_criteria: Points are correctly filtered based on target SSID and band selection flags (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequency/channel mappings).

title: Geodesic Coordinates to Metric Spatial Transform
description: The spatial module shall compute metric spatial steps and Euclidean/spherical distances using 111,320 meters per degree latitude and 111,320 * cos(avgLat) meters per degree longitude.
acceptance_criteria: Lat/lng degree steps match metric conversions accurately across varying latitudes.

title: Ray-Casting Polygon Containment Verification
description: The spatial module shall determine whether a coordinate is inside an arbitrary polygon using ray-casting intersection parity.
acceptance_criteria: Points strictly inside boundary return True, exterior points return False, and edge/vertex intersections are handled consistently.

title: Boundary Auto-Generation via Andrew's Monotone Chain
description: The spatial module shall construct the minimal convex hull enclosing coordinate points in sorted lexicographical order.
acceptance_criteria: Given N >= 3 non-collinear coordinates, when convex hull is computed, the minimal outer convex perimeter is returned in counter-clockwise order.

title: Resolution-Scaled Grid Cell Partitioning and RSSI Averaging
description: The grid analyzer shall group points into metric grid cells, dynamically scale grid resolution if total boundary cells exceed 40,000, and compute mean RSSI per cell.
acceptance_criteria: Cells group correct points, calculate exact mean RSSI, and adjust resolution when boundary cell count exceeds the 40,000 threshold.

title: Dead Zone and Low-Confidence Cell Classification
description: The grid analyzer shall classify cells with mean RSSI <= -76 dBm (or empty cells inside campus boundary) as dead zones, and cells with sample count < confidence threshold as gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Dead zone percentage and survey gap percentage match exact cell ratios inside the active campus boundary.

title: Automated Threshold Diagnostic Alerts and 2.4 GHz Congestion Detection
description: The diagnostic engine shall trigger danger alerts for dead zones > 25%, warning alerts for dead zones > 5%, info alerts for gaps > 30%, and congestion alerts for 2.4 GHz channels 1, 6, 11 having > 5 distinct BSSIDs.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts trigger deterministically when statistical conditions and channel congestion thresholds are crossed.

title: Project Configuration Serialization and Schema Integrity
description: The serialization module shall serialize boundary coordinates, loaded file names, and data points into a valid JSON schema and validate imported payloads against data corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Exported project JSON accurately restores all points, boundary vertices, and file lists upon deserialization.
